content: Nangʉ Tiitʉ awɨ, ʉbhɨ uriija abhaatʉ kʉrɨngʼaana na amiija ga amaheene.
Bhabhʉʉrɨrɨ abhakaruka, bhareenderwa kʉbha bhe ekerengo, bhasuuku na bha teemwa nzʉmu. Naatu bhabhɨ bhaheene bhu ubhwisirirya, kʉbhʉsɨɨgi na kubhwigumirirya.
Muyomuyo ʉbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ abhakɨkʉrʉ kʉbha, bhabhɨ ne eteemwa yɨnʉ ikumukumya Mungu. Bhatabha bhagʉbhi bha abhaatʉ, bhatabha bhanywi, nawe bhareenderwa kwija ubhwikari ʉbhʉzʉmu,
korereke bhabhɨ bhariija abhaacha kʉbhasɨɨga abhasubhɨ bhaabhʉ na abhaana bhaabhʉ.

Naatu abhaacha, bhabhɨ ne ekerengo, bhabhɨ bharonge, bhakore bhwaheene emeremo mumijɨ jabhʉ, bhabhɨ abhaatʉ abhazʉmu na bhʉ ʉkʉsʉʉka abhasubhɨ bhaabhʉ. Ʉbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ bhakorebhu, korereke ɨngʼana ya Mungu ɨtaregwa.
Na abhamura, ʉbhareche bhabhɨ bhe ekerengo.
Na naawɨ, mʉmangʼana gʉʉsi, ʉbhɨ ekerenjo chu ukwɨgwa kwabhʉ, ko kokora amazʉmu. Mumiija gaazʉ, werekenʼye amaheene nʉ ʉbhʉnagu.
Wiijɨ amiija ga amaheene korereke amiija gataririirirwa na abhaatʉ. Nʉʉrʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ areenda kʉgaanga, asʉʉkɨ, kʉ kʉbha atakʉbha ni ingʼana rya kʉtʉgamba kɨbhɨ.
Ʉbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ bhambʉʉsa, kʉbha bhasʉʉkɨ abhakʉrʉ bhaabhʉ, bhabhazomere kwa gʉʉsi, bhatahakaana nabhʉ.
Naatu bhatiibha, nawe bhabhɨ bhaheene, korereke amahocha gaabhʉ gʉʉsi gakore abhandɨ bharutwɨ na amiija ga Mungu Ʉmʉsabhuri wɨɨtʉ.
Ʉbhɨ uriija amangʼana gayo, kʉ kʉbha Mungu ɨrɨkɨɨnʼyɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ, ko koreeta ubhutuurya kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.
Ʉrʉbhangʉ ruyo, rʉratwija kwanga ʉbhʉbhɨ nu umwʉyʉ gwa kʉʉsɨ. Kwɨbhu hanʉ tʉkʉbha tʉkɨɨrɨ kʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ, tʉbhɨ bhe ekerengo, bhe eheene, na abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwikara ubhwikari bhu ukumukumya Mungu.
Twikarɨbhu, ɨnʉ turiisega urusikʉ rurya ʉrʉzʉmu rwʉ ʉkʉgarʉka kwa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Urusikʉ ruyo ararorekana mʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwazɨ. Ewe newe Mungu Ʉmʉkʉrʉ na nɨ‑Mʉsabhuri wɨɨtʉ.
Akiihurucha igʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ, korereke atʉsabhʉrɨ kurwa mʉbhʉbhɨ bhwʉsi. Akeenda kutwerya, korereke tʉbhɨ abhaatʉ bhaazɨ, bhanʉ bhanu umucha kokora amazʉmu.
Mmbe nangʉ, ʉbhɨ uriija amangʼana gayo gʉʉsi. Ʉhɨɨrwɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉsi bhwʉ ʉkʉhaara no okorecha abhaatʉ. Ʉtaregwa na mʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wurya.
